supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: minimal lateral extension beyond the outer ocular corners

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast between the light-toned muzzle and the dark/black periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate 2D vertical thickness with a clearly defined lower lip margin

other_distinctive_markers: horizontal linear object (likely a stick or plant stem) held in the mouth
